set.body:
Scheduling lane: film. Current plan: docs/refactor/PLAN.md. Live dependency edges supersede historical sequencing below.

Current disposition, 2026-09-19; governing docs/refactor/PLAN.md.
Preserved approved film-library scope. Follow S0-S4c order and exact text parity; the earlier annotation preview does not close this ticket.

Original scope retained below for evidence; fleet procedure/assignments are historical and do not govern single-developer work.

Plan: docs/plans/2026-09-18-best-recall-to-video-mapper.md §3 Phase 2 (Full film route); the D1A-film bead's ten carried questions.

Under ruling E, D1A-film is on the 1.0 path. It has no plan yet.

Scope:
A written phase plan and its tickets; no code.

Acceptance criteria:
1. A plan in docs/plans answers each of the ten questions carried on the D1A-film bead (bound proposal surface, identity rendering, context placement, the anchored within rule, Stage 1b provenance, mention ranking and tick-sized positions, the film status rule, anchored fingerprint rendering, the film court, the Sherlock adapter's repair receipts and two-part composition).
2. It is cold-reviewed by a fresh-context agent and every finding is folded or answered in the plan.
3. The film status rule is put to the owner as a decision, with the disclosures listed on the D1A-film bead.
4. Its slices are filed as child tickets of the D1A-film bead, each with acceptance criteria and blocking edges.

Gate: fresh-context cold review of the committed text; the commit body states what changed and
what it does not establish.

Size: M.
set.title: [film] D1A-film: write and cold-review its phase plan, then file its slice tickets
